description: This file provides utility functions for a frontend application to determine the API base URL and to perform fetch requests to the backend service, with environment variable support and URL normalization.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Returns the configured API base URL, defaulting to 'http://localhost:3001' if environment variable is unset, and normalizes by removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: apiFetch(path, options = {})
methods.description: Performs a fetch request to the backend API, prefixing the provided path with the base URL obtained from getApiBaseUrl. Supports optional fetch options.
